title: Uncapped desiredAPYBps converts directly into unbounded phUSD mint pressure; only friction is a 100-block (~20 min) two-step gate

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-1 'Two-step APY setting process (intentional security feature) - requires two calls within 100 blocks to commit' + KI-5 'Owner trust assumptions'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-1 documents that the mechanism EXISTS as a security feature. This finding's claim is exactly the opposite: SYMBOLIC-005 proves the gate works as advertised, and 'as advertised' is a 100-block delay — not a magnitude bound. Finding is that 20 minutes is insufficient to bound unbounded phUSD inflation. Extra scrutiny applied per High-severity caution rule; finding survives because the bug is the magnitude (no cap), not the mechanism.
